items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It might have been Chico Hamilton, because I know when Chico Hamilton did the show... Buddy was playing with Chico Hamilton.

ctx.x: If you are recounting when you were in Los Angeles in the late ’50s, ’58, there were other pianists there. Hampton Hawes. Did you get a chance to . . . ?
And Curtis Counce. Do you remember him? Curtis Counce?
